graph.name: Dow Jones NewsGrid AWS Architecture
graph.categories: Media & Content Handling, Serverless & Web Applications
graph.notes: Dow Jones powers its NewsGrid editorial platform using AWS AppSync, EC2, DynamoDB, Lambda, and Elasticsearch, achieving high availability and disaster recovery across AWS regions.

nodes.name: USERS
nodes.notes: Global users accessing the NewsGrid application on desktop and mobile devices.

nodes.name: ROUTE 53
nodes.notes: Handles DNS routing and disaster recovery region determination (Virginia vs. Oregon).

nodes.name: ELB
nodes.notes: Elastic Load Balancer routing incoming HTTP requests.

nodes.name: COGNITO
nodes.notes: Enforces user authentication using Cognito and Okta as an identity provider.

nodes.name: EC2 (Left)
nodes.notes: Application server running in Availability Zone 1.

nodes.name: EC2 (Right)
nodes.notes: Redundant application server running in Availability Zone 2.

nodes.name: APPSYNC
nodes.notes: Core GraphQL API handling queries, mutations, and real-time MQTT subscriptions.

nodes.name: ELASTIC SEARCH
nodes.notes: Elasticsearch cluster used for search, sorting, and advanced filtering.

nodes.name: LAMBDA
nodes.notes: Processes background jobs and syncs DynamoDB Stream updates into Elasticsearch.

nodes.name: DYNAMODB
nodes.notes: Primary persistent data store replicated across regions via Global Tables.

edges.notes: Users query Route 53 to resolve active regional target.
Users connect directly to Elastic Load Balancer.
ELB validates user session with Cognito/Okta.
ELB routes authenticated traffic to EC2 instance in AZ 1.
ELB routes authenticated traffic to EC2 instance in AZ 2.
EC2 proxies queries and mutations to AppSync API.
EC2 proxies queries and mutations to AppSync API.
AppSync writes and reads primary data from DynamoDB.
AppSync queries Elasticsearch for search and filtering functionality.
DynamoDB Streams trigger Lambda function on database mutations.
Lambda indexes updated records into Elasticsearch.
AppSync pushes real-time article updates to users via MQTT protocol.
